title: Termwise etale cohomology colimit
statement: For a small cofiltered category I and a limiting cone c over a diagram D of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, let F_i be complexes of abelian etale sheaves with inverse-image maps satisfying the identity and composition laws. Let G identify compatibly with their pullbacks to c.pt and let L be a colimit cocone of G. For any s in Z and r in N, let H identify with H^r(F_i^s), with arrows the complexTermCohomologyMap of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-complex-filtration-page-data]. A cocone B with point identified with H^r(L.pt^s) and legs those same canonical comparison maps is a colimit cocone. This is the degreewise application of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-limit-of-schemes], with no lower-bound hypothesis or spectral-sequence data.

proof.text: Use Mathlib IsFiltered.exists_directed (Stacks 0032) to choose a small nonempty directed partial order A and a final functor R : A to I.op. Its left opposite is initial, so c.whisker R.leftOp is limiting; compactness, quasi-separatedness and affine transitions are inherited from D. Finality preserves the colimit cocone L.whisker R.

Evaluate R composed with G and its colimit cocone at s. Mathlib HomologicalComplex evaluation preserves colimits. Set the stage sheaf at a to (F ((R.obj a).unop)).X s and its transition to (phi ((R.map f).unop)).f s. Evaluating hidentity, hcomposition and hG gives precisely the coherence assumptions of ordinary continuity. The evaluated eG gives the pullback identifications.

Apply nonempty_isColimit_etale_cohomology_of_isLimit to these evaluated sheaves in degree r, using the reindexed H and B. Expand complexTermCohomologyMap as the composite of cohomologyMap and Sheaf.H.map. Cancel eH.hom on the right of hH to obtain the required arrow equality; hB already gives the required cocone-leg equality. The result makes B.whisker R a colimit.
Transport the resulting colimit structure along Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv R B to conclude Nonempty (IsColimit B).

theorem nonempty_isColimit_complex_term_cohomology
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (F : ∀ i : I, CochainComplex (Sheaf (D.obj i).smallEtaleTopology
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : j ⟶ i),
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hidentity : ∀ i : I, φ (𝟙 i) =
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
        (eqToIso (congrArg (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (D.map_id i)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (F i) ≫
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj i))
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (F i))
    (hcomposition : ∀ (i j k : I) (f : j ⟶ i) (g : k ⟶ j),
      φ (g ≫ f) =
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g) (D.map f)
            (D.map (g ≫ f)) (D.map_comp g f))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map g)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (φ f) ≫ φ g)
    (G : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (Sheaf c.pt.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    (eG : ∀ i : I, G.obj (op i) ≅
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app i)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (F i))
    (hG : ∀ (i j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), G.map f.op =
      (eG i).hom ≫
        (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
          (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app j) (D.map f)
            (c.π.app i) (c.w f).symm) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom.app (F i) ≫
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app j)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (φ f) ≫ (eG j).inv)
    (L : Cocone G) (hL : IsColimit L) (r : ℕ) (s : ℤ)
    (H : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj (op i) ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H ((F i).X s) r))
    (hH : ∀ (i j : I) (f : j ⟶ i), H.map f.op ≫ (eH j).hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ complexTermCohomologyMap (D.map f) (F i) (F j) (φ f) r s)
    (B : Cocone H) (eB : B.pt ≅ AddCommGrpCat.of (Sheaf.H (L.pt.X s) r))
    (hB : ∀ i : I, B.ι.app (op i) ≫ eB.hom =
      (eH i).hom ≫ complexTermCohomologyMap (c.π.app i) (F i) L.pt
        ((eG i).inv ≫ L.ι.app (op i)) r s) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit B)
